# CANDIDATE: TURN_OF_MONTH_FIRST_HOUR_MOMENTUM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
On the last trading day of the month, the first hour often exhibits an upward bias due to institutional rebalancing, creating a short‑term momentum edge. This edge exists because institutional flows (e.g., month-end rebalancing, option expiration flows) create persistent buying pressure in the first hour after open on the last trading day of the month, which can be captured with a momentum filter.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If today is the last trading day of the month and time is between 09:30‑10:30 ET, require price > VWAP, price > EMA(9) (ribbon bullish), and volume > 1.5× the average volume of the first 30 minutes; then go long.
Exit shape: Stop at the opening range low (ORL) or 1% below entry, whichever is tighter; target at 2R or trail with a 15‑period chandelier exit.
Regime hint: Works across VIX levels but avoid if VIX > 30 (extreme volatility) or if a major macro event (FOMC, CPI) is scheduled same day.
